description: Stereo drive: each channel is pushed through a saturating curve of its own, and the two are then cross-mixed into both outputs

params.text: Sets the level of both inputs before the drive, from silence at the counter-clockwise end to twice the incoming voltage at the clockwise end
Sets the cross-mix between the channels: at the counter-clockwise end each output carries twice as much of the other channel as of its own, and at the clockwise end fifty times as much
Multiplies both channels again before the saturating curve, up to four times, so it sets how hard they are driven rather than how loud the module is

inputs.text: The left audio input, driven through a hyperbolic tangent, which flattens it as it grows; with the right input empty both outputs carry this channel
The right audio input, driven through a sine rather than a hyperbolic tangent, so a loud signal folds back on itself instead of flattening

outputs.text: Carries the driven left channel, inverted, plus at least twice as much of the driven right channel
Carries the driven right channel, inverted, plus at least twice as much of the driven left channel

notes: nothing in the module limits the output level; with both trimmers turned up the two jacks reach tens of volts
